purpose: Select held-out query episodes for prospective closed-loop behavioral validation across pre-existing difficulty strata.

eligibility_requirements: sufficient relevant-history capacity for the frozen matched-memory construction

stratification.rationale: Intentional disproportionate allocation to ensure prospective coverage of medium and hard episodes; not population-proportional sampling.

sampling.method: simple random sampling without replacement independently within each family x difficulty stratum
sampling.ordering_before_sampling: sort eligible episode IDs ascending within each stratum

estimands.primary_unweighted: behavioral effect in the intentionally enriched 4 easy / 3 medium / 3 hard experimental cohort
estimands.optional_population_weighted: summary reweighted only to the 40-episode held-out difficulty distribution of 50% easy / 25% medium / 25% hard
estimands.generalization_boundary: No claim of representativeness beyond the defined held-out benchmark episode pool without additional validation.

next_step: Generate and record exact selected episode IDs from the frozen rule before any closed-loop policy inference.
